title.zh: 币安账户被指与伊朗制裁网络及Zanjani关联转移约8.5亿美元
title.en: Binance Accounts Linked to Zanjani Moved About $850 Million

current_state.zh: 币安的一项调查将伊朗制裁网络与8.5亿美元转账联系起来，引发了对该交易所规避制裁和合规问题的担忧。
current_state.en: A Binance investigation has connected an Iran sanctions network to $850 million in transfers, raising sanctions-evasion and compliance concerns for the exchange.
